materials.content:
Watercolor and graphite on moderately thick, cream, smooth wove paper with a slightly fuzzy feel
(Source: Paper Survey researched by Judith C. Walsh and published in Lynes, 1999.)

cr_data.provenance: Estate of the artist, 1986; Private collection, 1987; (Mongerson Wunderlich, Chicago, Illinois); Gerald Peters Gallery, Santa Fe, New Mexico, 1992 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A woman in a blue dress stands at the center of the composition. She appears in profile but turns her head to look out at the viewer. The woman is surrounded by a loosely rendered, abstract scene in shades of blue and bright red.
title: Untitled (Woman in Blue Dress)
